what_it_does: New features and improvements Kinesis polling in real time mode is generally available on classic compute: In Databricks Runtime 19 and above, Amazon Kinesis polling with real time mode is generally available for Structured Streaming on classic compute. This page provides working code examples for real time mode queries in Structured Streaming, from simple stateless transformations to complex stateful processing with custom state management. Prerequisites To run the examples on this page, you need: A real time mode cluster configured and running.
